title: Question 22
passage:
Why don’t we spread the picnic blanket under that tree?
A. Good idea. It’ll be cooler in the shade. B. The blanket folds up into a small square. C. I put the extra napkins in the cooler.
passageZh:
我們把野餐墊鋪在那棵樹下，怎麼樣？
A. 好主意，樹蔭下會涼一點。
B. 那張墊子可以摺成一小方塊。
C. 我把多的餐巾放進保冷箱了。
